title: Which operator owns the next token?
hook: The right operand has its own rule for where parsing stops.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Prefix codes, strings, grammar productions and a stack.
doesNotKnow: Parse expressions with left and right binding powers to control precedence and associativity.

misconception: One numeric precedence value fully determines right-associative parsing.
objective: Parse expressions with left and right binding powers to control precedence and associativity.

claims.text: The right binding power controls which operators the right operand may absorb. Equal left and right powers here admit another exponent inside the right operand; subtraction uses a larger right threshold so equal-precedence subtraction remains outside.
